name: David Piper
features: fair receding hair, weathered friendly face, tall lean build, tweed and a pipe off the car
bio: The gentleman privateer with the green cars: Ferraris, Lolas and a 917K painted in his own British racing green, entered under his own name against the works teams and paid for by winning the Kyalami 9 Hours and the Springbok races every winter. Lost part of a leg filming Le Mans with Steve McQueen in 1970.
